scope: Germany V9 first-pass CPO tariff audit
guardrails: No tariff generalized beyond the explicit official source scope.
Third-party station data is discovery/supporting evidence only unless the official CPO source confirms the tariff.
Previously deferred CPOs are not re-audited without new evidence.

cpos.direct_payment: Spontanes Laden via Kreditkarte oder PayPal; standard tariff for e-mobilists without active SWS electricity contract.
cpos.scope_note: Official page states the standard tariff applies at public VBS charging stations in Speyer and surroundings; no start or blocking fee.

cpos.direct_payment: charge-it-easy app without prior registration and credit-card payment; official ad-hoc credit-card route also documented.
cpos.scope_note: Official current CPO page labels 0.55 EUR/kWh as Standardtarif for Stadtwerke card / charge-it-easy and separately confirms no-registration credit-card charging through charge-it-easy. Sessions below 0.50 EUR are rounded to 0.50 EUR. Roaming prices are explicitly excluded.

cpos.direct_payment: Public ladenetz stations expose ad-hoc/direct payment by app/web according to current station-level discovery sources.
cpos.reason: No current official Stadtwerke Landshut surface or authoritative EVSE-to-tariff feed exposing the exact direct/ad-hoc price was found. Current public station evidence confirms ad-hoc availability but leaves the direct price unknown. Household electricity tariffs and roaming/card offers are not substitutes.
cpos.unlock_needed: Official checkout/QR page for a Stadtwerke Landshut EVSE, or an official/open-data EVSE-to-direct-tariff field that can be tied to the operator's stations.
